steps.content: After an indeterminate passage of time, the currents finally subside. Light once again filters through the porthole as you breach the surface.
With leaden limbs, you struggle to pry open the hatch and climb atop the submarine, scanning your surroundings.
There is no trace of the expected rescue, no expedition team—just the Illusory Moon shrouded in misty shadows, and that small boat drifting silently below.
Everything remains exactly as it was when you first arrived.
Only Pylgia will never again emerge from beneath the water in her black diving suit... Your connection to her is now too distant to sense.
